attributes.description: Dalmia Bharat Sugar & Industries is mainly engaged in manufacturing of sugar, generation of power, manufacturing of Industrial alcohol and manufacturing of refractory products.[1]The company is among the youngest and largest sugar companies in India. Its is the fastest-growing sugar company with its presence in UP and Maharashtra.
